mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its recent trend compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% (as of t-1mo) and the signal is active.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 850,000 units signals weakening consumer demand for housing, which typically precedes a slowdown in overall economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 850.0, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate indicates a weakening manufacturing sector and labor market, which together signal an impending economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 100 and UNRATE rises above 6.0, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS above 2.5%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as higher interest rates reduce corporate profitability and equity valuations, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions, which typically boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth is above 100k (as of t-1mo).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 100.5 (index) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 100.5, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index level above 230 (as of t-2mo) indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to anticipated monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate above 6.5% signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 6.5, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.
